description: This file defines the TransactionDao class, which provides data access methods for the transactions table in a Flutter application using SQLite. It includes methods for inserting, updating, deleting, listing transactions with filters, computing monthly sums, and summing all transactions by type.

classes.name: TransactionDao
classes.description: Data access object for transactions table, providing CRUD and query operations.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new transaction record into the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction record identified by its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the transaction record with the specified ID.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions, optionally filtered by category, type, date range, with pagination support.

methods.name: monthlySums
methods.description: Calculates total income and expenses in the given month.

methods.name: sumAllByType
methods.description: Calculates the total amount for all transactions of a specific type.
